name: Form Filler Agent
description: Extract structured data from text using JSON schemas. Auto-populates from context, asks for missing fields via followup questions.

skills.name: Fill Form
skills.description: Extract structured data from text context according to a JSON schema. Auto-fills available fields and generates followup questions for missing or ambiguous data
skills.usage_notes: Use when you need to extract structured information from unstructured text, documents, or user responses. Supports multi-turn interactions for clarification
skills.output_format: JSON with status (complete/needs_followup), filled_data, followup_questions, partial_data, and missing_fields

context.description: Background information and context to extract the data from

schema.description: JSON schema describing all data items to be extracted from the context

conversation_id.description: Optional conversation ID for multi-turn interactions

followup_answers.description: Answers to followup questions from previous turn

query.description: Natural language input instead of structured followup_answers
